title: Recurring cloud misconfiguration — same resource, same control, repeated deviation
summary: Count of cloud resources flagged with the same control deviation more than once in a rolling 30-day window. A non-zero value signals that guided-remediation closed the symptom but the deviation-source (IaC drift, missing guardrail, owner gap) was not addressed. DORA Article 18(2) treats recurring incidents sharing a root cause as major; this KRI is the cloud-posture analogue at the control-effectiveness layer.

target.rationale: Zero recurrence is the steady-state target: a remediation should hold.

measurement.formula: count( resource_uid where same (resource_uid, deviation_class) appears in >1 distinct playbook run within window ).

inputs.name: runs
inputs.description: ingest-finding step executions in window, keyed by (resource_uid, deviation_class)

inputs.name: verified_close
inputs.description: re-scan step verifying remediation; recurrence is measured against verified-closed prior runs
